title: Two Avro Lancaster Crews - St Peter ad Vincula
memorial_details: description: PER ARDUA AD ASTRA/ THIS TABLET IS A MEMORIAL TO THE TWO ROYAL AIR FORCE/ LANCASTER CREWS WHO WERE SHOT DOWN AND KILLED/ IN THIS PARISH ON THE 19TH APRIL 1944/ THEIR NAME LIVETH FOR EVERMORE/ (Names)/ OH I HAVE SLIPPED THE SURLY BONDS OF EARTH/ PUT OUT MY HAND AND TOUCHED THE FACE OF GOD/ THIS MEMORIAL WAS ERECTED IN GRATEFUL APPRECIATION/ OF THEIR SACRIFICE BY GEORGE AND ALMA SPARROW
